BatchResultRow.description:
One row of ``GET /v1/batches/{batch_id}/results``.

Per-row outcome of batch processing. Successful rows carry the assigned
complaint_id; failures carry a problem detail describing the rejection.

complaint_id.description: Set on accepted=true. Absent on rejection.
complaint_id.title: Complaint Id

problem.description: Set on accepted=false. Mirrors the Tier 1 RFC 9457 envelope.

row_index.description: Zero-indexed row position in the source file.
row_index.title: Row Index

BatchResultRow.title: BatchResultRow

ProblemDetail.description:
RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.

Every non-2xx response carries this envelope under content type
``application/problem+json``. The ``type`` URI namespace is a placeholder
pending SBS sign-off; see docs/sessions/2026-05-18-prompt-05-open-questions.md.

errors.message: value 'XYZ' does not match INEI ubigeo pattern

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. The error catalog at api/openapi/error-catalog.md is the canonical list.
code.title: Code

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Plain Spanish or English.
detail.title: Detail

errors.description: When the problem is a validation failure across multiple fields, each individual field error is enumerated here. Omitted for single-field or non-validation problems.
errors.title: Errors

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence.
instance.title: Instance

status.description: The HTTP status code originally generated by the origin server.
status.title: Status

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem class.
title.title: Title

trace_id.description: W3C traceparent identifier of the request, propagated from OpenTelemetry. Institutions echo this in support requests.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

type.description: RFC 9457 'type' — a URI identifying the problem class. SBS uses the placeholder namespace https://sbs.gob.pe/errors/{code} until the namespace is confirmed.
type.title: Type

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail

field.description: JSON path of the offending field (e.g., complaint.complainant_district).
field.title: Field

message.description: Human-readable message describing the rule violation.
message.title: Message
